title: HOPPVALS cellular blind
description: HOPPVALS cellular blind, beige, 38x64" This energy-saving blind is inspired by bees. The honeycomb structure inside creates a layer of insulation which helps reduce heating costs. The cord is tucked inside safely out of reach of children. Can be mounted on the wall or ceiling.
features: RIKTIG draw rod makes it easier to pull down the blind.
RIKTIG draw rod is sold separately.
Different wall/ceiling materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the wall/ceiling in your home (not included).
materialAndCare: Fabric: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled); Top rail: Aluminum, Powder coating; Bottom rail: Galvanized steel, Powder coating, Polyester paint
